records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the third quarter of fiscal year 2021, we continued to make progress in our transition to the cloud, with Total ARR, or annualized recurring revenue, growing faster year-over-year than in the third quarter of fiscal year 2020, despite the prior year including strong demand associated with pandemic-related purchases to address the business continuity needs of our

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Deferred revenues decreased $124.1 million as of September 30, 2021 compared to December 31, 2020 primarily due to a decrease in deferred maintenance and support revenue of $316.1 million, mostly from Workspace perpetual software maintenance, partially offset by an increase from deferred subscription revenue of $193.8 million, which includes the Wrike

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Customers are also realizing the benefit of a lower total cost of ownership as they shift to our cloud services from our traditional perpetual license offerings.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Also, operating cash flows decreased $303.0 million to $512.8 million when comparing the nine months ended September 30, 2021 to the nine months ended September 30, 2020.
